rows.details: Bihar Teacher Recruitment Examination, Fourth Phase (TRE-4.0)
School Teacher (Primary, Middle, Secondary, and Senior Secondary levels)

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE 4.0 Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Important: BPSC's official press notice confirms only the total figure of 32,388 vacancies; it does not itself break this down by teaching level. The level-wise breakup below is as reported in early media coverage of this notification and should be verified against the detailed notification PDF once BPSC publishes it on bpsc.bihar.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE 4.0 Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Note: The qualification details below are as reported by early media coverage of this notification (not stated in BPSC's press notice itself) and should be cross-checked against the detailed notification once published. Candidates should hold a valid CTET or STET certificate for the respective paper corresponding to the post applied for.

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE 4.0 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Note: As reported by early media coverage, not stated in the official press notice itself. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Bihar Government rules for reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE 4.0 Pay Scale 2026
content_sections.text: Note: As reported by early media coverage, not stated in the official press notice itself. In addition to basic pay, selected teachers receive Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and medical benefits as per Bihar Government rules.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Note: As reported by early media coverage, not stated in the official press notice itself.

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE 4.0 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Note: As reported by early media coverage, not stated in the official press notice itself. Preliminary Test (PT) Main Written Examination Interview (for applicable posts) Document Verification Final Merit List Media reports indicate this is the first TRE cycle to introduce a two-tier exam pattern (Preliminary Test followed by Main Exam), replacing the single-stage written test used in earlier TRE phases, with no negative marking in the Preliminary Test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BPSC TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official BPSC website at www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in . Click on the BPSC TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 link once activated (from 1 September 2026). Register using a valid email ID and mobile number. Fill in personal, academic, and teaching qualification details. Upload required documents, photograph, and signature. Pay the application fee online. Submit the form and download the confirmation page for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BPSC TRE 4.0?
faq.answer: BPSC has notified 32,388 School Teacher vacancies under Advertisement No. 14/2026.

faq.question: Q2. When does the BPSC TRE 4.0 application process start?
faq.answer: Fee payment and online applications both begin on 1 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BPSC TRE 4.0?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 30 September 2026; the fee payment window closes a day earlier, on 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which posts are covered under BPSC TRE 4.0?
faq.answer: Primary Teacher, Middle School Teacher, Secondary Teacher, and Senior Secondary Teacher posts under the Education Department, Government of Bihar.

faq.question: Q5. Where can candidates find the detailed notification?
faq.answer: BPSC's press notice directs candidates to the official website www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in for the detailed advertisement, eligibility criteria, and application instructions.

faq.question: Q6. Is a CTET or STET certificate required?
faq.answer: As reported by early media coverage, candidates need a valid CTET or STET qualification for the respective paper corresponding to the post; this should be confirmed against the detailed notification once published.
